target_customer: Designers, agencies and small SaaS or membership businesses building on Webflow, WordPress or custom front ends
problem: Adding logins, gated content and subscription payments to a no code site normally needs custom backend work.
business_model: SaaS subscription tiers plus a transaction fee on payments (4 percent on the basic tier down to 0 percent)
product_category: Membership, authentication and payments layer for no code sites

founders.name: Duncan Hamra
founders.background_notes: Crunchbase lists product designer; Latka lists CEO, titles conflict.

founders.name: Tyler Bell
founders.background_notes: Company says they built it because they needed the product themselves.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed a drop in script layer over Webflow with auth, Stripe subscriptions and gating, plus APIs, which is standard but fiddly engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Once member data and payments live in the tool migration is painful, but alternatives such as Outseta exist and Webflow could build natively.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: One Outseta page claims Webflow was abandoning its native membership feature, unverified; Memberstack remained active in 2026.

market_need_then: Webflow users in 2019 and 2020 had no native member login or paywall, and Memberstack reached Product Hunt number one in July 2019 and over 1,000 paying customers by October 2020.

identity.visual_style: Clean SaaS marketing with a showcase gallery of customer sites
identity.voice_and_tone: Builder friendly, no code and developer APIs

branding.brand_signature: Webflow first positioning and a public build in public showcase of customer projects
branding.community_and_virality: Webflow community launch July 2019 and Product Hunt number one product of the day the same month; podcast interviews with Makerpad and DEV community.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong niche recognition in the Webflow ecosystem and a Product Hunt win, but no evidence of broad consumer brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Memberstack found demand inside the Webflow community, hit Product Hunt first in 2019, passed 1,000 customers by late 2020 and raised a 2M seed from Gradient Ventures. It remains active with a team of 8 and claims over 200M processed, a capital efficient niche business with no later priced round found.
notes: Seed date conflicts: CB Insights says 2020-02, Caplight 2020-10-06; the company blog dated 2020-10-07 says it was raised earlier in 2020. Amount of 2M is supported by Seedtable and CB Insights. Company about page reportedly lists a January 2020 pre-seed led by Gradient Ventures, unverified and not recorded. Two AI profile sites say 150K and are discounted. Dated competitor sources from 2020 were not found; Outseta (founded 2016 per a directory) existed but no dated source. Traction figures are company reported.
